notes: Wishing someone sticks now. The Wish button used to come back every time you opened the app, so the same colleague could be wished the same birthday over and over — wish once and it stays done, and it returns just once on the day itself if you got in early. Search remembers where you have been: open it and your recent pages, people and accounts are right there, with an X on any row and a Clear all. In My Cashbook, a bill you attached opens properly — a PDF bill used to arrive as a broken image. And if you run your phone at a larger text size, the filter chips on Attendance and Payroll no longer get sliced off; every chip in the app now grows with your text instead of cutting the label off. For managers and HR: emergency leave has its own tab under Approvals, where you can confirm one that stands or reject one that should not, and a leave's type or dates can now be corrected without rejecting it and asking for it again.
